known_limitations: Effective entry is existing runtime confirmation AND validated observed quote availability AND observed spread divided by closed ATR strictly less than 0.10; this method only vetoes an existing direction.

Requires the original quote's availability flag, bid-close/ask-close/spread agreement, in-candle quote timestamp and exact closed-bar availability timestamp. Missing or inconsistent observations produce WAIT.
ATR variant is the simple arithmetic mean of 14 completed true ranges, not Wilder recursive smoothing; immature or zero ATR is unavailable.
0.10 and the trend-up London normal-volatility context are bounded prospective lab hypotheses, not empirically optimal or publisher-qualified settings.
Observed spread is a method input only. Physical modeled execution spread, slippage, commission, risk and account controls remain unchanged.
This declaration creates no agent policy, independent market validation, economic credit, Master status or paper/live authority.
